title: Air Fryer Coconut Shrimp
description: This coconut shrimp air fryer recipe makes a quick and healthy appetizer of crisp, succulent shrimp served with a sweet and spicy honey-lime dip.
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.text: Stir together flour and pepper in a shallow dish. Lightly beat eggs in a second shallow dish. Stir together coconut and panko in a third shallow dish.

Working one at a time, dredge shrimp in flour mixture; shake off excess. Dip floured shrimp in egg; allow any excess to drip off. Finally, dredge in coconut mixture, pressing to adhere. Place shrimp on a plate. Coat shrimp well with cooking spray.

Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Place 1/2 of the shrimp in the air fryer and cook about 3 minutes. Turn shrimp over and continue cooking until golden, about 3 minutes more. Season with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
Meanwhile, whisk together honey, lime juice, and serrano chile in a small bowl.
Sprinkle fried shrimp with cilantro and serve with honey-lime dip.

video.description: The coconut shrimp air fryer recipe in this video always turns out nicely and it's delicious served with a simple, tangy honey-lime dip. The real coconut in the breading gives this classic appetizer an unforgettable tropical flavor that contrasts nicely with the spicy dip. Serve these bite sized seafood delicacies from the air fryer as finger foods or as a main course with some fresh, fruity sides.
